# R006 — Reported Lower Palaeolithic evidence in northern Kerala

Ramesh N. K.'s 2016 article attributes surface-collected stone tools from river terraces in northern Kerala to the Lower Palaeolithic on typological grounds.

**Evidence type:** `archaeological_claim`  
**Geographic relation:** `core`  
**Places:** Northern Kerala; individual sites awaiting report review

## Limitations

Surface finds without excavation, stratigraphy or absolute dating; terrace finds may have been moved by the river. Tool typology does not establish a species or an exact first-arrival year.
